summary: Rocket One Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the increase of the maximum aggregate offering price under its existing At-The-Market (ATM) Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright Co. to an additional $6,829,000, bringing total shares sold to ~$9.3 million. The filing includes a prospectus supplement and legal opinion from Sheppard Mullin. This is a routine shelf takedown under a pre-existing equity distribution agreement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change is involved.
